headline: One Software Technologies Acquires 62% Controlling Stake in Peax Solutions for NIS 358M
summary: Israel's One Software Technologies acquired private equity firm FIMI's 62% stake in IT firm Peax Solutions for NIS 358 million.
why: One Software Technologies is a major IT services provider in Israel; corporate buyouts expand enterprise software market share.
